_comment: Regression/acceptance gate for videodl. Every case runs through the PUBLIC entry point of the artefact under test (source, a built binary, a candidate container image, or the deployed container). update-from-upstream.sh promotes a build only when every non-optional case passes. Keep URLs stable and public; mark flaky third-party sites optional.

cases.name: indaplay-progressive
cases.note: PeerTube API path; `-f worst` resolves to the HLS 360p variant (19.3 MB, byte-range fMP4) — the size floor caught a BtbN ffmpeg master snapshot that wrote only the first segment and exited 0 (2026-09-13)

cases.name: indaevents-delegation
cases.note: site→host delegation incl. the slug-resolution fallback (embed 500s upstream)

cases.name: youtube-extract
cases.note: Big Buck Bunny (Blender, CC). Exercises InnerTube client rotation.

cases.name: ytdlp-fallback
cases.note: a site only the yt-dlp engine handles — proves the bundled yt-dlp works

cases.name: vimeo-extract
cases.note: Vimeo changes often; reported but does not gate

cases.name: ssrf-loopback-rejected
cases.note: SSRF guard: loopback must be refused before any request is made

cases.name: output-traversal-rejected
cases.note: -o must never leave the download directory

cases.name: solver-sandbox-denies-fs
cases.note: the challenge-solver child must run under Node --permission: a payload reading /etc/passwd via process.getBuiltinModule('fs') must get ERR_ACCESS_DENIED
